svg.title: Feature Flags
svg.desc: Feature Flags. Deploy code dark, then turn features on per user or percentage at runtime. Step 1, Deploy dark: Build 41 ships the new checkout path behind a flag that is off: deployed, but not released. Step 2, Target, then roll out: On for staff, then 10% and 50% of customers. Each SDK decides from its own copy of the rules. Step 3, Kill switch: Errors climb on the new path, so the flag goes off: every instance is back on the old path. Step 4, Finish and clean up: The fix ships and the flag goes to 100%. The next release deletes the flag and the old path.

g.text: Build 41 ships the new checkout path behind a flag that is off: deployed, but not released.
On for staff, then 10% and 50% of customers. Each SDK decides from its own copy of the rules.
Errors climb on the new path, so the flag goes off: every instance is back on the old path.
The fix ships and the flag goes to 100%. The next release deletes the flag and the old path.

g.text: pushes each change to every SDK

the new path ships switched off.

each SDK decides from its copy of the rules.
Flag service down? SDKs keep the last rules;

the flag goes back on, for everyone.

and the old path, or both turn into debt.
